High Society New Buffalo

Cannabis Near Union Pier, Lakeside & Three Oaks (Quick Drive to New Buffalo)

Right off US-12 with easy parking and fast pickup—perfect for Harbor Country weekends and lake days.

At A Glance

Directions & Parking

  1. Getting here from Union Pier (via Red Arrow Hwy → US-12)

    1. Head south on Red Arrow Hwy (M-63) toward New Buffalo.
    2. Merge onto US-12 and continue toward 19189 US Hwy 12.
    3. Look for High Society—easy in/out from the highway.

    Get Directions

  2. Getting here from Three Oaks (straight shot on US-12)

    1. Take US-12 W toward New Buffalo.
    2. Stay on US-12 to 19189 US Hwy 12.

    Get Directions

  3. Getting here from Lakeside (fastest local route → US-12)

    1. Take Red Arrow Hwy (M-63) south toward New Buffalo.
    2. Continue onto US-12 and follow it to 19189 US Hwy 12.

    Get Directions

  4. Parking

    Parking Notes: Free lot on-site, best for quick grab-and-go stops. If it’s peak summer traffic, aim for earlier afternoon or later evening for the easiest in/out.

Fast Pickup, Friendly Team

Walk in, get checked in, and head to the counter. Most visits take under 10 minutes. Our team can point you to popular categories and answer questions. We accept cash and debit; ATMs are available on site. The store and parking are accessible.

For Harbor Country trips

  • Quick stop before the beach, marina, or heading back to your rental

  • Close to the Indiana border and the main New Buffalo corridor (US-12)

  • Friendly reminder: Enjoy responsibly in Michigan—don’t travel across state lines with cannabis

Crossing state lines

Visiting from out of state? Read our guide to Michigan marijuana laws before you shop.

FAQ

Do you have parking?

Yes — on-site lot for easy in/out.

What ID do I need?

Valid government-issued photo ID; 21+ only.

Do you take cards?

Debit is commonly accepted at dispensaries; confirm at checkout or call ahead.

How long does pickup take?

Most quick pickups are ~10 minutes once you’re parked.

What are your hours?

Typically 9am–9pm daily.
